title: The Four Great Works of Sin and the Apostle's Separation of Light from Darkness
description: The four great works by which Sin organizes humanity against itself — the lust of the mouth (appetite), fornication (lust), wealth and boasting (possession), war and tyranny (dominion) — set against the single saving work brought by the Apostle: the separation of Light from Darkness, the Beautiful from the Bad, received as faith, thanksgiving, and obedience. The proprium displayed in every direction of natural life answered by the one revealed truth that orders the soul.
